column2: kunit: Make slub_kunit unaffected by user specified flags

column1: slub_kunit does not expect other debugging flags to be set when running
tests. When SLAB_RED_ZONE flag is set globally
flag affects number of errors reported.
To make slub_kunit unaffected by user specified debugging flags
introduce SLAB_NO_USER_FLAGS to ignore them. With this flag
specified in the code are used and others are ignored.
